name: Regulars
description: Loyalty stamps on Bitcoin Cash: pay a shop and receive its stamps in the same transaction, then redeem them for BCH from a reserve the shop locked up front.

customer.name: Customer
customer.description: Pays the shop and holds its stamps.

merchant.name: Shop
merchant.description: Opens a shop, is paid by its customers, and can close it.

earn.name: Pay and earn stamps
earn.description: Pay a shop and take the stamps that payment earns from its issuer contract, in one transaction.

redeem.name: Redeem stamps
redeem.description: Hand stamps to the shop's reward reserve and take the BCH they are worth.

redeemFresh.name: Redeem stamps (first redemption)
redeemFresh.description: Hand stamps to a reward reserve nobody has redeemed against yet, and take the BCH they are worth.

openShop.name: Open a shop
openShop.description: Mint the stamp supply into an issuer contract and lock a reward reserve, in one transaction.

closeIssuer.name: Retire an issuer output
closeIssuer.description: Take back the stamps an issuer output has not given out. Accrued protocol fees, if any, go to the protocol.

withdrawReserve.name: Withdraw the reward reserve
withdrawReserve.description: Take the reward reserve's BCH and handed-in stamps back to the shop.

earnTransaction.name: Earned stamps
earnTransaction.description: Paid a shop and earned $(<stamps>) stamps.

openShopTransaction.name: Opened a shop
openShopTransaction.description: Minted $(<supply>) stamps into an issuer contract and locked $(<reserveFunding>) satoshis as the reward reserve.

closeIssuerTransaction.name: Retired an issuer output
closeIssuerTransaction.description: The shop took back its unissued stamps.

withdrawReserveTransaction.name: Withdrew the reward reserve
withdrawReserveTransaction.description: The shop took its reward reserve back.

issuerInput.name: Stamp issuer
issuerInput.description: The shop's issuer contract output being drawn from.

reserveInput.name: Reward reserve
reserveInput.description: The shop's reward reserve being redeemed against.

freshReserveInput.name: Reward reserve
freshReserveInput.description: A shop's reward reserve that holds no stamps yet.

closeIssuerInput.name: Stamp issuer
closeIssuerInput.description: One of the shop's issuer outputs, retired by the shop key.

withdrawReserveInput.name: Reward reserve
withdrawReserveInput.description: The shop's reward reserve, withdrawn by the shop key.

issuerOutput.name: Stamp issuer
issuerOutput.description: The issuer contract, recreated with fewer stamps and the protocol fee added.

shopPaymentOutput.name: Payment to shop
shopPaymentOutput.description: What the shop receives for the stamps earned.

stampsOutput.name: Stamps
stampsOutput.description: $(<stamps>) loyalty stamps, redeemable at the shop reserve.

freshReserveOutput.name: Reward reserve
freshReserveOutput.description: The reserve, recreated holding its first handed-in stamps and less BCH.

shopIssuerOutput.name: Stamp issuer
shopIssuerOutput.description: The issuer contract holding the whole stamp supply.

shopReserveOutput.name: Reward reserve
shopReserveOutput.description: BCH locked to pay for redeemed stamps.

announceOutput.name: Shop announcement
announceOutput.description: Names the shop and its key hash on chain, so anyone can rebuild its link.

shopRefundOutput.name: Back to the shop
shopRefundOutput.description: BCH returned to the shop key when it closes a contract output.

protocolFeeOutput.name: Protocol fees
protocolFeeOutput.description: Fees the issuer output accrued, forwarded to the protocol.

reserveOutput.name: Reward reserve
reserveOutput.description: The reserve, recreated holding the handed-in stamps and less BCH.

shopIssuerLockingScript.name: Stamp issuer contract (shop)
shopIssuerLockingScript.description: The shop's view of its issuer contract: the same script, built from the shop key, so the shop can retire it.

shopReserveLockingScript.name: Reward reserve contract (shop)
shopReserveLockingScript.description: The shop's view of its reward reserve, built from the shop key, so the shop can withdraw it.

shopKeyLockingScript.name: Shop payments
shopKeyLockingScript.description: Payments to the shop, locked to the shop key.

issuerLockingScript.name: Stamp issuer contract
issuerLockingScript.description: Releases a shop's stamps only in a transaction that pays the shop for them.

reserveLockingScript.name: Reward reserve contract
reserveLockingScript.description: Pays a fixed amount of BCH for every stamp handed in.

shopLockingScript.name: Shop
shopLockingScript.description: The shop's own address, where payments go.

stampsLockingScript.name: Stamps
stampsLockingScript.description: Loyalty stamps held by the customer's own key.

tokenDust.name: Token output value
tokenDust.description: Satoshis carried by an output holding tokens.

ownerKey.name: Stamp key
ownerKey.description: Key that holds the stamps the customer earns.

stampCategory.name: Stamp token
stampCategory.description: Token category of the shop's stamps, as wallets show it.

merchantPkh.name: Shop key hash
merchantPkh.description: hash160 of the key the shop is paid to.

satsPerStampEarned.name: Sats per stamp
satsPerStampEarned.description: The customer earns one stamp per this many satoshis paid.

satsPerStampRedeemed.name: Reward per stamp
satsPerStampRedeemed.description: Satoshis the reserve pays for each stamp.

feePerStamp.name: Protocol fee per stamp
feePerStamp.description: Satoshis per stamp issued that stay in the issuer for the protocol.

protocolPkh.name: Protocol key hash
protocolPkh.description: hash160 of the protocol treasury key.

issuerSatoshis.name: Issuer satoshis
issuerSatoshis.description: Satoshis on the issuer output being spent.

issuerStamps.name: Issuer stamps
issuerStamps.description: Stamps on the issuer output being spent.

reserveSatoshis.name: Reserve satoshis
reserveSatoshis.description: Satoshis on the reserve output being spent.

reserveStamps.name: Reserve stamps
reserveStamps.description: Stamps already handed in to the reserve output being spent.

stamps.name: Stamps
stamps.description: Number of stamps to earn or redeem.

merchantKey.name: Shop key
merchantKey.description: Key the shop is paid to; the only key that can close its contracts.

supply.name: Stamp supply
supply.description: Stamps minted into the issuer contract when the shop opens.

reserveFunding.name: Reserve funding
reserveFunding.description: Satoshis locked in the reward reserve when the shop opens.

refundSatoshis.name: Refund
refundSatoshis.description: Satoshis returned to the shop key after the network fee.

forwardSatoshis.name: Forwarded fees
forwardSatoshis.description: Accrued protocol fees forwarded when an issuer output is retired.
